newsitem.title: FRANCE: Embattled Mobutu leaves France for Zaire.
newsitem.headline: Embattled Mobutu leaves France for Zaire.

text.p: Zaire's ailing President Mobutu Sese Seko left France for home on Friday in a last-ditch attempt to save his crumbling authority in face of growing support for rebels led by Laurent Kabila, witnesses said.

The 66-year-old Zairean leader, who has spent most of his time in Europe since he had prostate cancer surgery last August, took off from Nice airport for Kinshasa at 9.45 a.m.(0845 GMT) after issuing a call for national unity and a ceasefire rejected by the rebels on Thursday night.
